The '''Systech electric blaster''' was the more advanced model of the [[Systech static blaster|static blaster]] developed by the [[Systech Corporation/Legends|Systech Corporation]] for use against [[Veermok/Legends|veermok]], a ferocious primate found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. These primates were highly resistant to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, therefore this weapon's damage was mostly electrical, allowing it to bypass the resistance.
